_comment: Cross-language contract for IRC message-kind classification. Asserted by irc.TestSemanticKindsContract (Go) and web/tests/semantics-contract.test.ts. The web client consumes server-computed display_kind + is_self/mentions_me/counts_as_unread directly, so the ONLY set it still mirrors is presenceKinds (web/src/messages.ts PRESENCE_KINDS); nonUnreadKinds/sysKinds guard the server constants. Arrays are sorted. Edit this together with irc/semantics.go and the web mirror.
